verdict.rationale: Vast.ai explicitly supports custom Docker images and templates: docs describe building templates to 'Package your environment so any GPU can run it with one click,' opening custom ports for any docker image via docker create/run options, and templates as the mechanism for setting up rented machines with whatever software/formatting is needed. This is corroborated by CLI/API access for template management and prebuilt example templates (PyTorch, vLLM, ComfyUI) that can be copied and customized. missing for 10: independent hands-on report specifically validating custom Docker image deployment (community evidence is about pricing/reliability, not template/image workflow).
